description: Get project metadata and the Godot version, plus a runtime block. runtime.activeSession, sessionMode and bridgeResponsive describe the current session, projectPath its project (null when none), liveSessions all live ones. With projectPath, runtime.project is that project's session: live, exited or none. Returns: { name?, projectPath?, structure?, godotVersion, runtime }; warnings leads if structure is partial or the engine is newer than the project. Errors if projectPath lacks project.godot.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory (optional - omit to get Godot version and runtime status only). An empty string is treated as omitted.

name: check_project

bridgeResponsive.description: Whether the current live session answered a ping. null when the ping was not sent because another runtime operation was still running; diagnostics says which.
